title: Shadow Cat on Haunted Pier
description: A black cat with glowing white eyes runs across a long wooden pier or bridge structure at night, leaving purple glowing paw prints behind. The scene is framed within a futuristic metallic border with digital readouts, while red wind chimes hang from the wooden rafters above the foggy, dystopian city skyline.
prompt: A black spectral cat with glowing white eyes dashes across a long wooden pier at night, leaving a trail of luminous purple paw prints. The covered bridge has wooden beams and red wind chimes hanging from the rafters. In the background is a foggy futuristic city skyline with neon lights. The entire scene is contained within a metallic sci-fi digital frame with glowing interface elements, dark surreal atmosphere, cinematic lighting
